description: Manage a sales pipeline from stage definition through weekly health reviews.

steps.description: Define pipeline stages with entry and exit criteria for each.

inputs.name: sales-process-description
inputs.desc: Description of the current sales motion

inputs.name: average-deal-size
inputs.desc: Typical deal value and sales cycle length

outputs.name: stage-definitions
outputs.desc: Named stages with entry and exit criteria

outputs.name: stage-probabilities
outputs.desc: Win probability assigned to each stage

process: List each pipeline stage from first contact to closed-won.
Define the entry criteria that move a deal into each stage.
Define the exit criteria that advance a deal to the next stage.
Assign a win probability percentage to each stage.

steps.description: Track deal progression speed and identify stuck deals.

inputs.name: deal-list
inputs.desc: Current deals with stage and age

outputs.name: velocity-metrics
outputs.desc: Average days per stage and conversion rates

outputs.name: stuck-deals
outputs.desc: Deals exceeding stage time thresholds

process: Calculate average time in each stage across all deals.
Flag deals that exceed 1.5x the average stage duration.
Compute stage-to-stage conversion rates.
Rank stuck deals by value and age.

steps.description: Forecast revenue by applying stage probabilities to the pipeline.

outputs.name: weighted-forecast
outputs.desc: Expected revenue by period

outputs.name: forecast-confidence
outputs.desc: Confidence range based on pipeline coverage

process: Multiply each deal value by its stage probability.
Sum weighted values by close date period.
Calculate pipeline coverage ratio against target.
Produce confidence intervals for each period.

steps.description: Review pipeline health and produce the weekly pipeline report.

outputs.name: pipeline-report
outputs.desc: Weekly pipeline health summary

outputs.name: action-items
outputs.desc: Specific actions to move stuck deals or fill gaps

process: Compare this week's pipeline to last week's.
Identify new deals, lost deals, and stage changes.
List the top three risks to the forecast.
Write action items for each stuck deal and coverage gap.

description: Build and calibrate a lead scoring model from ICP definition through threshold validation.

steps.description: Define the ideal customer profile with demographic and firmographic attributes.

inputs.name: product-description
inputs.desc: What the product does and who benefits

outputs.name: icp-attributes
outputs.desc: Ranked list of ICP attributes and values

outputs.name: icp-summary
outputs.desc: Narrative description of the ideal customer

process: Analyze closed-won deals for common attributes.
Rank attributes by correlation with conversion.
Define the must-have vs nice-to-have attributes.
Write the ICP summary.

steps.description: Assign point values to demographic and behavioral scoring signals.

outputs.name: scoring-matrix
outputs.desc: Points assigned to each signal

outputs.name: decay-rules
outputs.desc: Time-based score decay for stale signals

process: Map each ICP attribute to a point value based on its correlation rank.
Map each behavioral event (page visit, download, demo request) to points.
Define negative scoring for disqualifying signals.
Set decay rules for behavioral scores older than a threshold.

steps.description: Set thresholds that classify leads as hot, warm, or cold.

outputs.name: score-thresholds
outputs.desc: Numeric boundaries for hot, warm, cold

outputs.name: threshold-validation
outputs.desc: Backtested accuracy of thresholds against historical data

process: Score historical leads using the matrix.
Plot score distributions for converted vs non-converted leads.
Set thresholds to maximize separation between groups.
Calculate precision and recall at each threshold.

steps.description: Document the scoring model and produce the calibration plan.

outputs.name: scoring-model-document
outputs.desc: Full documentation of the scoring model

outputs.name: calibration-plan
outputs.desc: Schedule and criteria for quarterly recalibration

process: Document every signal, its point value, and the rationale.
Document the thresholds and their backtest performance.
Define the quarterly calibration process.
Specify the data pulls and metrics for each calibration cycle.

description: Qualify deals using structured criteria from BANT gathering through go/no-go recommendation.

steps.description: Gather budget, authority, need, and timeline information for a deal.

inputs.name: deal-description
inputs.desc: Overview of the deal and prospect

inputs.name: discovery-notes
inputs.desc: Notes from discovery calls and meetings

outputs.name: bant-assessment
outputs.desc: Scored assessment of each BANT dimension

outputs.name: information-gaps
outputs.desc: BANT questions still unanswered

process: Extract budget signals from discovery notes.
Identify the decision maker and buying process.
Assess the urgency and specificity of the need.
Determine the timeline and any deadline pressures.

steps.description: Evaluate the competitive landscape for this deal.

outputs.name: competitive-assessment
outputs.desc: Position relative to known competitors

outputs.name: differentiation-points
outputs.desc: Where the offering is stronger or weaker

process: List the known competitors in this deal.
Assess the prospect's evaluation criteria.
Map strengths and weaknesses against each competitor.
Identify the primary differentiation points.

steps.description: Identify risks and blockers that could prevent the deal from closing.

outputs.name: risk-register
outputs.desc: Ranked list of deal risks

outputs.name: mitigation-actions
outputs.desc: Actions to address each risk

process: Score each risk dimension (budget risk, champion risk, timing risk, competitive risk).
Rank risks by likelihood and impact.
Define a mitigation action for each high-priority risk.
Identify any showstopper risks that cannot be mitigated.

steps.description: Score the opportunity and make a go/no-go recommendation.

outputs.name: qualification-score
outputs.desc: Composite score for the opportunity

outputs.name: qualification-assessment
outputs.desc: Go/no-go recommendation with rationale

process: Compute the composite qualification score from BANT, competitive, and risk scores.
Apply the qualification threshold.
Write the recommendation (pursue, deprioritize, or disqualify).
Document the rationale and any conditions.

description: Analyze won and lost deals to find patterns and improve the sales process.

steps.description: Select a representative sample of won and lost deals for analysis.

inputs.name: analysis-scope
inputs.desc: Time period and segments to analyze

outputs.name: deal-sample
outputs.desc: Selected deals for review

outputs.name: sample-criteria
outputs.desc: How the sample was chosen and what it represents

process: Define the time window and segments to include.
Select deals stratified by size, segment, and outcome.
Verify the sample is large enough for pattern detection.
Document the selection criteria.

steps.description: Collect feedback from buyers on why they chose or rejected the offering.

outputs.name: feedback-responses
outputs.desc: Collected buyer feedback by deal

outputs.name: response-rate
outputs.desc: Percentage of buyers who participated

process: Draft the feedback questionnaire (decision criteria, experience, competitors considered).
Contact each buyer by email or call.
Record responses in a structured format.
Note the response rate and any non-response bias.

steps.description: Categorize reasons and identify patterns across won and lost deals.

outputs.name: win-loss-patterns
outputs.desc: Categorized reasons with frequency counts

outputs.name: segment-differences
outputs.desc: How patterns differ by deal size, segment, or competitor

process: Categorize each response by primary reason (price, product, relationship, timing, competitor).
Count the frequency of each reason for wins and losses separately.
Cross-tabulate by segment, deal size, and competitor.
Identify statistically significant patterns.

steps.description: Produce the win-loss report with findings and recommendations.

outputs.name: win-loss-report
outputs.desc: Analysis report with findings and recommendations

outputs.name: improvement-actions
outputs.desc: Prioritized actions to improve win rate

process: Summarize the top reasons for wins and losses.
Highlight the most actionable findings.
Recommend process, messaging, or product changes.
Prioritize actions by expected impact on win rate.

description: Plan and balance sales territories by market potential and rep workload.

steps.description: Analyze total addressable market by geography or segment.

inputs.name: segmentation-criteria
inputs.desc: How to divide the market (geography, vertical, size)

outputs.name: market-potential-map
outputs.desc: Potential revenue by territory unit

outputs.name: segment-profiles
outputs.desc: Description of each segment and its characteristics

process: Define the territory units (zip code, state, industry, named accounts).
Estimate the addressable revenue in each unit.
Rank units by potential.
Group units into candidate territories.

steps.description: Balance territories by opportunity and workload.

outputs.name: balanced-territories
outputs.desc: Territory assignments balanced for fairness

outputs.name: balance-metrics
outputs.desc: Variance in potential and account count across territories

process: Calculate the target potential per territory.
Assign units to territories to minimize variance.
Check account count and travel distance constraints.
Iterate until balance metrics are within tolerance.

steps.description: Set quotas for each territory based on potential and historical performance.

inputs.name: historical-performance
inputs.desc: Past attainment by territory or rep

outputs.name: territory-quotas
outputs.desc: Quota for each territory

outputs.name: quota-rationale
outputs.desc: How each quota was derived

process: Start from the territory's market potential.
Adjust for historical conversion rates in similar territories.
Factor in rep experience and ramp status.
Document the derivation for each territory.

steps.description: Produce the territory plan with assignments, quotas, and strategies.

outputs.name: territory-plan
outputs.desc: Full territory plan document

outputs.name: territory-strategies
outputs.desc: Specific go-to-market strategy per territory

process: Document each territory's accounts, quota, and rep assignment.
Write a one-paragraph strategy for each territory.
Include the balance metrics and fairness analysis.
Set the review cadence for territory adjustments.

description: Build a weighted pipeline sales forecast with scenario modeling.

steps.description: Collect pipeline data by stage, value, and expected close date.

inputs.name: crm-export
inputs.desc: Current pipeline export from the CRM

outputs.name: pipeline-snapshot
outputs.desc: Cleaned pipeline data for the forecast period

outputs.name: data-quality-flags
outputs.desc: Missing or suspect data points

process: Filter the pipeline to the forecast period.
Flag deals with missing close dates or stale stages.
Normalize deal values to a common currency if needed.
Produce the cleaned snapshot.

steps.description: Calculate historical stage-to-stage conversion rates.

outputs.name: conversion-rates
outputs.desc: Historical conversion rates by stage

outputs.name: trend-analysis
outputs.desc: Whether rates are improving or declining

process: Calculate the win rate from each stage over the past four quarters.
Identify any trends in conversion rates.
Segment rates by deal size and segment if sample size allows.
Flag stages where current pipeline behavior differs from historical.

steps.description: Apply weighted pipeline methodology to produce the forecast.

outputs.name: weighted-forecast
outputs.desc: Expected revenue by period

outputs.name: scenario-models
outputs.desc: Best, likely, and worst case forecasts

process: Multiply each deal by its stage-specific conversion rate.
Sum by forecast period to get the likely case.
Apply optimistic rates for the best case and pessimistic for the worst.
Calculate the spread between scenarios.

steps.description: Produce the forecast report with scenarios and recommendations.

outputs.name: forecast-report
outputs.desc: Sales forecast document

outputs.name: gap-analysis
outputs.desc: Shortfall to quota and pipeline needed to close the gap

process: Compare the forecast to quota.
Calculate the pipeline gap (additional pipeline needed).
Highlight the top deals driving the forecast.
Recommend actions to close any gap.

description: Process a deal from quote generation through contract execution and order processing.

steps.description: Generate a quote from the product catalog and pricing rules.

inputs.name: deal-requirements
inputs.desc: What the customer needs (products, quantities, terms)

inputs.name: pricing-rules
inputs.desc: Pricing tiers, discounts, and approval thresholds

outputs.name: draft-quote
outputs.desc: Quote with line items, pricing, and terms

outputs.name: approval-needed
outputs.desc: Whether the quote requires internal approval

process: Map the requirements to catalog items.
Apply standard pricing and any negotiated discounts.
Calculate the total and check against approval thresholds.
Produce the draft quote document.

steps.description: Route the quote for internal approvals from pricing, legal, and finance.

outputs.name: approved-quote
outputs.desc: Quote with all approvals obtained

outputs.name: approval-conditions
outputs.desc: Any conditions or modifications from approvers

process: Route to pricing for discount approval if above threshold.
Route to legal for non-standard terms.
Route to finance for payment terms or credit approval.
Collect all approvals and any conditions.

steps.description: Send the quote, negotiate terms, and finalize the contract.

outputs.name: final-contract
outputs.desc: Executed contract with agreed terms

outputs.name: negotiation-log
outputs.desc: Record of changes made during negotiation

process: Send the quote to the customer.
Track requested changes and counter-proposals.
Negotiate within approved boundaries.
Finalize and execute the contract.

steps.description: Process the order and produce the confirmation.

outputs.name: order-confirmation
outputs.desc: Order record with fulfillment details

outputs.name: handoff-package
outputs.desc: Information package for the delivery or implementation team

process: Create the order record from the contract.
Verify fulfillment details against the contract.
Generate the order confirmation for the customer.
Prepare the handoff package for delivery.

description: Plan a strategic account from org mapping through quarterly business review scheduling.

steps.description: Map the account's organization chart and decision makers.

outputs.name: org-map
outputs.desc: Organizational chart with decision makers identified

outputs.name: relationship-gaps
outputs.desc: Key stakeholders not yet engaged

process: List all known contacts and their roles.
Map the reporting structure and decision-making process.
Identify the economic buyer, technical buyer, and champion.
Flag stakeholders with no existing relationship.

steps.description: Assess current revenue and identify expansion opportunities.

outputs.name: wallet-share-analysis
outputs.desc: Current share of the account's spend in this category

outputs.name: expansion-opportunities
outputs.desc: Specific growth opportunities identified

process: Calculate current revenue from this account.
Estimate the account's total spend in this category.
Compute the wallet share percentage.
List specific products or departments not yet served.

steps.description: Set measurable account objectives and engagement activities.

outputs.name: account-objectives
outputs.desc: Measurable goals for the account

outputs.name: engagement-plan
outputs.desc: Activities and timeline to achieve objectives

process: Set revenue and relationship objectives for the next 12 months.
Prioritize expansion opportunities by value and feasibility.
Plan engagement activities for each relationship gap.
Set milestones and review dates.

steps.description: Produce the account plan and set the QBR schedule.

outputs.name: account-plan
outputs.desc: Full strategic account plan

outputs.name: qbr-schedule
outputs.desc: Quarterly business review dates and agenda framework

process: Compile the org map, objectives, and engagement plan into the account plan.
Set the QBR cadence and standard agenda.
Distribute the plan to the account team.
Set the first QBR date.

description: Create a sales playbook with personas, talk tracks, and competitive battle cards.

steps.description: Define the target buyer personas for the playbook.

inputs.name: customer-interviews
inputs.desc: Interviews or feedback from existing customers

outputs.name: buyer-personas
outputs.desc: Detailed persona profiles

outputs.name: pain-points
outputs.desc: Key problems each persona faces

process: Identify the distinct buyer roles involved in purchasing.
Define each persona's title, responsibilities, and goals.
Map the pain points each persona experiences.
Describe how each persona evaluates solutions.

steps.description: Write talk tracks and objection handling for each persona.

outputs.name: talk-tracks
outputs.desc: Conversation guides for each persona and stage

outputs.name: objection-responses
outputs.desc: Responses to common objections

process: Write the opening value statement for each persona.
Script discovery questions tied to each pain point.
Write responses to the top five objections.
Create the closing language for each deal stage.

steps.description: Build competitive battle cards for each major competitor.

outputs.name: battle-cards
outputs.desc: One-page competitive comparison per competitor

outputs.name: trap-questions
outputs.desc: Questions that expose competitor weaknesses

process: Profile each competitor's offering, pricing, and positioning.
Identify strengths and weaknesses relative to your offering.
Write the trap questions that highlight competitor gaps.
Create the one-page battle card per competitor.

steps.description: Assemble all components into the final sales playbook.

outputs.name: sales-playbook
outputs.desc: Complete sales playbook document

outputs.name: quick-reference
outputs.desc: One-page cheat sheet for the field

process: Organize the playbook by sales stage.
Include personas, talk tracks, and battle cards in each section.
Create the one-page quick reference card.
Set the update cadence for the playbook.

description: Analyze customer churn and design retention interventions.

steps.description: Calculate retention and churn rates by cohort and segment.

inputs.name: customer-data
inputs.desc: Customer records with start dates, end dates, and segments

outputs.name: churn-metrics
outputs.desc: Churn and retention rates by cohort and segment

outputs.name: cohort-charts
outputs.desc: Cohort retention curves

process: Define cohorts by signup period.
Calculate the churn rate for each cohort at each time interval.
Segment by customer type, size, or product.
Produce the retention curves.

steps.description: Segment churned customers by reason and identify leading indicators.

inputs.name: customer-feedback
inputs.desc: Exit survey responses and support ticket history

outputs.name: churn-reasons
outputs.desc: Categorized reasons for churn with frequency

outputs.name: leading-indicators
outputs.desc: Behavioral signals that precede churn

process: Categorize churn reasons from exit surveys and cancellation flows.
Analyze support ticket patterns in the months before churn.
Identify product usage patterns that correlate with churn.
Rank leading indicators by predictive strength.

steps.description: Design interventions to address the top churn drivers.

outputs.name: intervention-playbook
outputs.desc: Designed interventions for each churn driver

outputs.name: alert-rules
outputs.desc: Automated triggers based on leading indicators

process: Design an intervention for each of the top three churn reasons.
Define the trigger criteria for each intervention.
Set up automated alerts based on leading indicators.
Estimate the expected impact on retention.

steps.description: Produce the retention analysis report with findings and action plan.

outputs.name: retention-report
outputs.desc: Analysis report with findings and recommendations

outputs.name: tracking-plan
outputs.desc: Metrics and cadence to track intervention effectiveness

process: Summarize churn trends and their financial impact.
Present the top churn drivers with supporting data.
Document each intervention and its expected impact.
Define the tracking metrics and review cadence.

description: Design a sales compensation plan from role definition through payout modeling.

steps.description: Define the sales roles and their selling motions.

inputs.name: revenue-model
inputs.desc: How revenue is generated (new, expansion, renewal)

outputs.name: role-profiles
outputs.desc: Each role's selling motion, cycle, and deal size

outputs.name: pay-philosophy
outputs.desc: Compensation philosophy and market positioning

process: List each distinct sales role.
Define the selling motion for each (hunting, farming, hybrid).
Describe the typical deal size and cycle length.
State the target market percentile for total compensation.

steps.description: Set on-target earnings and the base-to-variable pay mix.

outputs.name: pay-mix-structure
outputs.desc: OTE, base, and variable split per role

outputs.name: market-comparison
outputs.desc: How the proposed pay compares to market

process: Set the on-target earnings for each role.
Determine the base-to-variable split (e.g., 50/50 for hunters, 70/30 for farmers).
Compare against market data.
Adjust for geographic and experience differentials.

steps.description: Choose the incentive mechanics, accelerators, and SPIFs.

inputs.name: pay-mix-structure
inputs.desc: OTE and pay mix by role

outputs.name: incentive-plan
outputs.desc: Mechanics including rates, accelerators, and decelerators

outputs.name: spif-calendar
outputs.desc: Planned sales performance incentive funds

process: Set the commission rate or bonus formula for each role.
Design accelerators for above-quota performance.
Define decelerators or floors for below-quota performance.
Plan any time-bound SPIFs for strategic priorities.

steps.description: Model payout scenarios and produce the compensation plan document.

outputs.name: payout-scenarios
outputs.desc: Modeled payouts at 80%, 100%, 120%, 150% attainment

outputs.name: compensation-plan-document
outputs.desc: Final compensation plan ready for distribution

process: Model total compensation at four attainment levels.
Calculate the cost to the company at each level.
Verify that top performers earn meaningfully more than quota.
Produce the plan document with examples.

description: Respond to an RFP or proposal request from bid decision through submission.

steps.description: Analyze the RFP requirements and evaluation criteria.

outputs.name: requirements-matrix
outputs.desc: Each requirement mapped to a capability

outputs.name: gap-analysis
outputs.desc: Requirements that cannot be fully met

process: Extract every requirement from the RFP.
Map each requirement to a company capability.
Identify gaps where the requirement is not fully addressed.
Note the evaluation criteria and scoring weights.

steps.description: Make a bid/no-bid decision based on fit and probability of winning.

outputs.name: bid-decision
outputs.desc: Go or no-go with rationale

outputs.name: win-probability
outputs.desc: Estimated probability of winning

process: Score the fit based on requirements coverage.
Assess the competitive landscape for this bid.
Estimate the cost of responding versus the expected value.
Make and document the bid/no-bid decision.

steps.description: Assign section owners and draft each section of the proposal.

outputs.name: draft-sections
outputs.desc: Drafted sections of the proposal

outputs.name: section-assignments
outputs.desc: Who owns each section and the deadline

process: Break the proposal into sections matching the RFP structure.
Assign each section to a subject matter expert.
Draft each section addressing the specific requirements.
Include evidence, case studies, and data where requested.

steps.description: Compile, review, and submit the final proposal.

outputs.name: final-proposal
outputs.desc: Compiled and reviewed proposal document

outputs.name: submission-record
outputs.desc: Proof of submission with timestamp

process: Compile all sections into the required format.
Verify compliance with every stated requirement.
Conduct a final review for consistency and accuracy.
Submit by the deadline and record the submission.
